summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: Package @servicetitan/dte-unlayer@0.150.3 declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` to run a bundled script `math_init.js`. That script is ~727KB of heavily obfuscated JavaScript using obfuscator.io-style rotated string arrays (`WV8StW` rotator, `n7gIxM` constant array) and hex-named identifiers (`_0x...`). The package's advertised purpose is a wrapper around the Unlayer email editor, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time or to execute an obfuscated payload. Using a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled script during `npm install` runs attacker-controlled code on every installer host and is structured to evade Node-based static scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
